verdict.rationale: Eqvista lists a 'Spreadsheet Import' feature on its pricing page and publishes migration guides for moving cap tables from Carta and Pulley, which points to its own way of loading historical equity data in bulk rather than entering it item by item. However, the evidence is only titles and line items, and part of the migration is a white-glove service run by Eqvista's team rather than a self-serve bulk tool. Missing for 10: documentation of what the spreadsheet import covers (grants, transfers, historical transactions), any self-serve bulk issuance of new grants, details of the import format or validation, and independent or hands-on confirmation.
